intro: The Agamand Family Axe is an ancestral heirloom preserved within the Agamand family crypt in northern Tirisfal Glades. Once a martial symbol of the wealthy mill-owning dynasty, it is sought by Coleman Farthing to strip the undead family of their remaining dignity.

p: Before the Third War, the Agamand dynasty reigned as prosperous landowners across the northern hills of Tirisfal Glades, maintaining vast mills and a private family crypt. The Agamand Family Axe rested among the ancestral arms entombed alongside deceased patriarchs and warriors, kept intact on underground weapon racks even as the Scourge overran the estate and slaughtered its inhabitants.

When the Scourge raised the fallen Agamands as mindless thralls to the Lich King, their former servant Coleman Farthing survived—in undeath—with bitter hatred for his old masters. Farthing blames the family for his own demise and commissions Forsaken wanderers to enter the crypt, strip the weapon racks of the axe, sword, mace, and dagger, and erase the final vestiges of the Agamand heritage.
